fact: Derro cultists swarm the chamber to protect a mysterious egg.
source_quote: The Derro cultists, their minds twisted beyond reason by the manipulations of sinister forces, swarmed the chamber with fanatical purpose.
subject: Derro ambush begins

fact: Plinki was grappled by Zalthir at the end of the previous chapter.
source_quote: Plinki has been grappled (by Zalthir, at the end of chapter 19)
subject: Plinki

fact: Gyrgum was sitting over the eggs.
source_quote: Gyrgum was sitting over the eggs
subject: Gyrgum

fact: The Derro cultists conclude that Gyrgum must be killed and his heart dropped over the egg.
source_quote: the crazed derro have all concluded Gyrgum "has to be killed. And his heart dropped over the egg."
subject: Derro cultists

fact: The Derro cooperate out of necessity and when riled up by a charismatic leader.
source_quote: they cooperate "out of necessity and when riled up by a charismatic leader"
subject: Derro

fact: Gyrgum intends to protect the egg but is willing to steal it if necessary.
source_quote: "So I want to protect this egg, but I'm willing to steal it if that's the best way to do that."
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Daz has a plan to steal the egg.
source_quote: Daz already has a plan to steal the egg.
subject: Daz's plan

fact: A Derro spy shoots Eldeth with a crossbow bolt.
source_quote: A Derro spy emerges from the shadows and severely wounds Eldeth with a crossbow bolt.
subject: Eldeth wounded

fact: Eldeth takes 12 points of damage and is reduced to four hit points.
source_quote: Eldeth takes 12 points of damage and is down to four hit points.
subject: Eldeth

fact: A second Derro spy attempts to shoot Daz but misses.
source_quote: A second spy attempts to shoot Daz but misses.
subject: Second spy misses Daz

fact: A Derro swings at Zalthir with disadvantage and misses.
source_quote: A Derro marches up and swings at Zalthir with disadvantage, rolling a 15 against AC 16 — a miss.
subject: Derro misses Zalthir

fact: Thorin engages a Derro warrior with his longsword.
source_quote: Thorin engages a Derro warrior, utilizing his longsword to impose disadvantage on the enemy's next attack.
subject: Thorin attacks Derro

fact: Thorin hits Derro #6 for 9 points of damage.
source_quote: he hits derro #6 for 9
subject: Thorin hits Derro 6

fact: Derro 6 has disadvantage on its next attack due to Thorin's Sap mastery.
source_quote: his longsword's Sap mastery gives the target disadvantage on its next attack.
subject: Derro 6

fact: A spectator materializes from the darkness and joins the fight.
source_quote: a beholder-kin creature known as a spectator materialized from the darkness, its many eyes gleaming with malice as it joined the assault.
subject: Spectator appears

fact: One of the party's helpers hits the spectator for 10 points of damage.
source_quote: One of the helpers hits the spectator for 10.
subject: Helper attacks spectator

fact: Plinki attempts to attack Gyrgum but fails due to the surrounding darkness.
source_quote: Plinki attempts to attack Gyrgum but fails to land a blow due to the surrounding darkness.
subject: Plinki misses Gyrgum

fact: Daz conjures a giant earthen hand that restrains the spectator.
source_quote: Daz conjured a massive hand of compacted earth that surged up from the ground and seized the spectator, pinning it in place
subject: Daz restrains spectator

fact: The spectator is restrained by Daz's earthen hand.
source_quote: the spectator is restrained ("There's a big hand on top of it")
subject: Spectator

fact: Daz retreats into the darkness to avoid being targeted.
source_quote: Daz then retreats into the darkness so he can't be targeted.
subject: Daz retreats

fact: An enemy crossbowman hits Gyrgum for six points of damage.
source_quote: Enemy crossbowmen fire blindly: one hits Gyrgum for six
subject: Gyrgum hit by bolt

fact: Zalthir maneuvers through the magical darkness to strike at the Derro.
source_quote: Zalthir maneuvers through his own magical darkness to strike at the Derro.
subject: Zalthir attacks

fact: Gyrgum calls upon a ghostly ally to protect the egg.
source_quote: Gyrgum called upon his ghostly ally to defend the egg
subject: Gyrgum summons ghost

fact: Zalthir unleashes a breath attack in a cone, killing Plinki.
source_quote: Zalthir unleashed a terrifying breath that swept across the chamber in a wide cone, killing the fanatical Derro leader Plinki outright
subject: Zalthir kills Plinki

fact: Plinki is dead.
source_quote: killing the fanatical Derro leader Plinki outright
subject: Plinki

fact: Zalthir's breath attack leaves the surviving Derro blinded.
source_quote: killing the fanatical Derro leader Plinki outright and leaving the survivors blinded and reeling.
subject: Survivors blinded
